items.title: Clarks accelerates store expansion in Europe, with France leading the way
items.summary: Shoe brand Clarks opens a second store in Paris and plans three additional French locations this year. At the same time, the British group is expanding its retail and wholesale network in various European markets.

items.title: [In the Picture] Atelier Rebul opens first Belgian flagship store at Wijnegem Shopping Center
items.summary: The Turkish beauty brand Atelier Rebul opened its first Belgian flagship store at the Wijnegem Shopping Center on Wednesday. According to Benelux CEOs Xander Gielen and Kris Gielen, the turnout exceeded all expectations.

items.title: ESM's Retail Wrap – REWE, EU Beer, SPAR Austria, Atlantic Grupa
items.summary: REWE expands private-label range with REWE PWR; EU beer production declines in 2025, SPAR Austria launches digital shopping list.

items.title: Colmar brothers launch new youth-oriented restaurant concept “Crunch”
items.summary: The family behind the Colmar and Crocodile restaurant chains is once again focusing on fast food. With Crunch, CEO David and COO Devigné Van den Weghe are launching a new takeout concept aimed at young people and students. The first three locations will open in the coming weeks…

items.title: Morrisons Foundation Launches £1m Community Fund
items.summary: The Morrisons Foundation has launched a £1 million (€1.16 million) fund to help local charities upgrade community spaces.

items.title: US brewer FIFCO USA renamed under new owner
items.summary: US brewer FIFCO USA is being renamed North American Breweries (NAB) following its acquisition by private-equity firm Saothair.

items.title: Organto Foods Posts 61% Increase In Revenue In Q2
items.summary: Canadian organic produce supplier Organto Foods has reported sales growth of 61%, to CAD $27.7 million (€17.3 million), in Q2 2026.

items.title: H&M unveils new designer collection with Elie Saab
items.summary: H&M has named its newest designer collaborator, Lebanon-founded fashion house Elie Saab. Mr Elie Saab was one of the first members of France’s prestigious Chambre Syndicale de la Haute Couture. According to the retailer, the new collection will reflect Saab’s “contemporary”…

items.title: Lidl Expands Global Footprint To 13,000 Stores
items.summary: Lidl has opened a new store in Raunheim, Germany, marking its 13,000th store worldwide.

items.title: Spain’s Félix Solís Avantis buys three Rioja wine brands
items.summary: The family-owned group Félix Solís Avantis has acquired the local wine brands Federico Paternina, Lagunilla and Rioja Santiago.

items.title: UK “must learn from other countries” to strengthen food supply chain
items.summary: The UK must “learn” from other countries to protect its food supply chain against disruptions, says a new report. The post UK “must learn from other countries” to strengthen food supply chain appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Podcast: Tenzing eyes “functional” benefits as next phase in UK energy-drinks push
items.summary: Tenzing is stepping up its efforts in functional energy-drinks, arguing “only natural” is no longer sufficient to stand out in a rapidly evolving category.

items.title: Mars Reports Largest Annual Reduction In Emissions Across Global Value Chain
items.summary: Mars, Incorporated has reached its largest annual reduction in greenhouse gas emissions across its global value chain, down 6.4%.

items.title: La Patate aims to raise up to 1 million euros from the public
items.summary: The French fry chain La Patate, founded by content creator Average Rob, is launching a crowdlending campaign on Winwinner on September 9. The company aims to raise between 500,000 and 1 million euros to finance new locations.

items.title: H&M swaps Chaussée d’Ixelles for a larger store on Avenue Louise
items.summary: H&M is leaving the Chaussée d'Ixelles in Brussels after thirty years. The Swedish fashion chain will close its doors there at the end of October and move to a store of about 2,000 square meters on Avenue Louise.

items.title: Slazenger unveils padel club in Exeter
items.summary: Slazenger has unveiled Slazenger Padel Exeter, a 35,000 sq. ft padel club located at Haven Banks, Exeter.

items.title: Clarks opens second store in Paris
items.summary: Clarks has opened a new store at 11 Boulevard de la Madeleine in Paris.

items.title: “Canned fish manufacturers are omitting crucial information”
items.summary: While overfishing is becoming a pressing problem, canned fish sold in Belgian and Dutch supermarkets lack sufficient transparency regarding their origin. “The fishing industry is like the Wild West,” says Bart van Olphen, founder of the Fish Tales brand.

items.title: Tyson issues another profit warning
items.summary: Tyson Foods has cut its forecasts for sales and profits again, a month after warning persistent cattle shortages would deepen losses in its beef business. The post Tyson issues another profit warning appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Lidl now has 13,000 stores worldwide
items.summary: With the opening last Thursday of a 1,200 m² supermarket in Raunheim, not far from Frankfurt in the German state of Hesse, Lidl reached the milestone of 13,000 active stores worldwide.

items.title: Belgian scale-up Gus Foods plans to roll out smart fridges nationwide
items.summary: Gus Foods, which is offering an alternative to company cafeterias with its smart refrigerators stocked with fresh meals, has secured new funding to accelerate its nationwide rollout.

items.title: “People are really focused on the health and wellness aspect of their beverage” – Westrock Coffee CCO on functional drinks focus
items.summary: Westrock Coffee’s CCO Kyle Newkirk discusses the group’s investment plans, non-alc beverage trends and navigating coffee price volatility.

items.title: US Convenience Stores Say Looming Healthy Food Rule Puts Food Stamps Use At Risk
items.summary: US convenience stores could cease accepting food stamps unless the USDA delays a rule requiring more fresh produce and protein in stores.

items.summary: Chief compliments officer Gillian Anderson returns for M&S’s autumn campaign, which celebrates the “shared love of style amongst women”. The new campaign is the third instalment of its ‘Love That’ brand platform, which was M&S’s highest-scoring fashion campaign ever according to…

items.title: Kick-Off For VOG – Here Is What The New Season Has In Store
items.summary: The Consortium is preparing to face the season with production expected to be in line with last year’s and a complete portfolio.

items.summary: The FAO has warned the "risk premium" is building in food as its index tracking five commodities reached an almost four-year high in August. The post “Risk premium” building in food as prices highest since 2022 – FAO appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Alimentation Couche-Tard Reports 10% Growth In Adjusted EBITDA In Q1
items.summary: Circle K parent Alimentation Couche-Tard has reported strong results in the first quarter of its 2027 fiscal year.

items.title: Asda and Felix hit 50m meal surplus food milestone
items.summary: Asda and food redistribution charity Felix have redistributed the equivalent of 50 million meals through their 13-year partnership.

items.title: Barilla buys better-for-you mac and cheese brand Goodles
items.summary: The deal will expand the startup's reach internationally while giving the pasta giant a greater presence in functional foods.

items.title: Campbell’s chases more savings as bleak outlook delays turnaround
items.summary: The Campbell’s Company plans to close another snacks plant as the Kettle chips maker guided to another year of falling sales and profits. The post Campbell’s chases more savings as bleak outlook delays turnaround appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Lululemon lowers outlook as sales fall due to weak Americas performance
items.summary: Lululemon has cut its full-year forecast, as second-quarter sales plummeted due to a weakened performance in its Americas region.

items.title: IKEA: price pressure is changing what consumers expect from their homes
items.summary: Affordability is playing an increasingly important role in how consumers furnish their homes. Still, many people continue to invest in smaller improvements, especially when it comes to storage space. This is according to Ikea’s new global “Life at Home” study.

items.title: Brico Planit to join Colruyt on former Makro site
items.summary: Progress is being made on the redevelopment of the former Makro site in Deurne. Following the announcement that Colruyt Professionals will open there on September 16, Brico Planit says it is aiming for early 2027. The chain will also begin operating the existing drive-through…

items.title: Food supply chain is “insufficiently prepared” for upcoming extreme El Niño
items.summary: The current El Niño could become the strongest in decades. The World Meteorological Organization warns of major consequences for precipitation, heat, and flooding. The food industry faces the threat of crop failures, as well as higher-priced raw materials, logistical…

items.title: Leftovers: Hershey’s fills up on fillings | Red Baron brings new spark to microwave pizza
items.summary: The sweets giant is launching new chocolate bars with creamy fillings, while Monster's Flrt flirts with fall in its first flavor innovation.

items.title: World Food Prices At Highest Since 2022 As Supply Risks Mount, FAO Says
items.summary: World food prices hit their highest since late 2022 in August as adverse weather and Black Sea war disruptions raised supply concerns - FAO.
